external.title: Connect the household coordinator
external.description: Enter the reviewed private coordinator URL and bearer token. Setup checks schedules without creating or changing them.

embedded.title: Run inside Home Assistant
embedded.description: Timers, alarms and announcement state are stored locally and restored after restarts. No add-on or token is needed. Audio uses the Home Assistant internal URL; optionally override it with an HA address reachable by Music Assistant and your speakers. Playback cannot run while Home Assistant is stopped. Configure speakers and enable features after setup.

reconfigure.title: Home Assistant audio address
reconfigure.description: Use an address reachable by Music Assistant and the selected speakers. This changes the audio origin without deleting local schedules or recordings.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read coordinator schedules. Verify reachability and API compatibility.
error.invalid_config: Enter a valid HTTP(S) URL and token of at least 32 characters.
error.invalid_audio_url: Set a reachable Home Assistant HTTP(S) origin without a path or credentials, or configure the internal URL in Home Assistant network settings.

abort.external_reconfigure: For an external coordinator, update its authentication through reauthentication or configure a new coordinator entry.

init.title: Household voice settings
init.description: Choose rooms, exact speakers and phones, then review and save. Live features start disabled. Settings changes do not play audio; the separate pairing test requires confirmation and saved enabled settings.

menu_options.phone: Add or edit a home phone
menu_options.native_audio_recovery: Recover built-in speaker after uncertain audio

announcements.title: Default announcement speakers
announcements.description: Choose one Music Assistant endpoint per speaker and an optional chime. Audiobooks and podcasts resume after announcements if playback remains unchanged. Phones receive the transcript when home. Choose whether to trust the current home state or require a report within five minutes or one hour. Away, unknown and unavailable phones are skipped.

phone.title: Select a home phone
phone.description: Choose the phoneÃ¢â‚¬â„¢s registered presence tracker. Selecting an existing tracker edits its mapping.

phone_details.title: Phone notification mapping
phone_details.description: Tracker: {tracker}. Choose its registered mobile app notification action. Delivery checks this exact tracker is home; unknown or unavailable receives nothing. Phones receive transcript text only, with no audio link or attachment.

satellite.title: Select the voice satellite
satellite.description: Choose exactly one Assist satellite entity OR ESPHome device. Device selection supports output-less firmware with no Assist entity. This records an explicit mapping and does not prove pairing or event authentication.

satellite_details.title: Satellite room and speakers
satellite_details.description: Satellite: {satellite}. Choose its room ID and one Music Assistant reply speaker, plus any room players to lower while listening. Duck factor is a fraction of each playerÃ¢â‚¬â„¢s current volume. The completion action must belong to this voice device; the runtime verifies authenticated ownership before calling it.

remove.title: Remove a prepared mapping
remove.description: Removes only the selected mapping from this draft. Select Review and save afterward to persist the change. No HA device or entity is deleted.

review.title: Review and save household voice settings
review.description: Default speakers: {speakers}. Phones: {phones}. Satellites: {satellites}. Master live actions: {live}. Saving validates the current registries, preserves your feature switches, and requests integration reload. Enabled features can act on subsequent voice requests or scheduled events.

media.title: Music Assistant room and profile
media.description: Enter the coordinator room ID and choose one Music Assistant player for this room. Its Music Assistant instance is verified from the entity registry. Use the existing profile name and default sleep-story playlist. Saving prepares routing and does not start playback. Re-entering a room replaces its saved music mapping.

features.title: Enable household voice features
features.description: The master switch and each feature switch must both be on for its live actions. These are administrator settings. Before enabling recording, assign each capture STT entity to a dedicated pipeline used only by its mapped voice device, and configure matching coordinator capture profiles. Saving requests a reload; it does not trigger playback.

data.satellite_audio_enabled: External replies with custom satellite firmware (advanced)
data.announcements_enabled: Recorded announcements and home phone text
data.echomuse_audio_enabled: Paired EchoMuse external replies (requires companion app)
data.native_room_ducking_enabled: Lower room speakers during native assistant conversations (beta)

alarms.title: Alarm speakers for a room
alarms.description: Choose explicit Music Assistant alarm speakers for this room. Saving the same room replaces its alarm mapping. Fallback speakers are optional and used only by the ringing policy when a configured target is unavailable. Ring volume and fallback selection apply to all rooms.

capture.title: Dedicated recording STT profile
capture.description: Select an existing mapped voice device and its underlying speech-to-text provider. Each source needs its own profile and exclusive Assist pipeline; speech metadata does not identify the microphone. The coordinator must have the same profile ID, source device and source room. No recording begins by saving. Re-entering a profile replaces its mapping.

test_pairing.title: Test a saved speaker pairing
test_pairing.description: Tests saved settings only. Save changes and reopen options first. With live actions and speaker replies enabled, confirming this test may play a short reply on the selected room speaker. It does not prove microphone recording or wake-word detection.

audio_recovery.title: Recover one saved speaker
audio_recovery.description: Use this only after checking that all pending announcement audio on the chosen speaker has stopped. It clears the local uncertainty block, but sends no stop or resume command and cannot prove physical silence. Active local announcements cannot be reset. Only saved routing is eligible; save new mappings first.

data.confirm_audio_stopped: I verified that all pending announcement audio has stopped

conversation_routing.title: Conversation routing
conversation_routing.description: Choose the assistant for ordinary requests. Household Voice handles announcement requests directly. After saving, select Household Voice router in the voice pipeline. Switch the pipeline back before clearing this selection.

single_turn_announcements.title: Single-turn original-voice announcements
single_turn_announcements.description: Say the command and message together. A compatible forced-alignment server locates your message in the original recording. If the boundary cannot be verified, you will be asked to repeat the message. Ordinary speech-to-text servers are not compatible. Enter the server base URL (for example http://speech:8000); /v1/audio/transcriptions is added automatically. Leave the API key empty to keep the saved key.

assistant_pairing.title: Assistant speakers
assistant_pairing.description: Rooms come from Home Assistant. A room with one suitable Music Assistant speaker pairs automatically; when there are several, choose a default below. Existing choices stay saved. No device IDs or YAML are needed. Finish with Review and save.

data.assistant: Assistant in its Home Assistant room

assistant_speaker.title: Speaker for {assistant}
assistant_speaker.description: Home Assistant room: {area}. Current status: {status}. Automatic follows this room; choose a speaker to set a default, or No paired speaker for built-in alarm and timer audio. In the native-conversation beta, replies stay on the assistant while paired speakers handle music, books, announcements, alarms and timers. This selection does not move existing schedules or change broadcast defaults. Finish with Review and save.

knowledge_family.title: Knowledge and family settings
knowledge_family.description: Family-friendly knowledge uses your existing local model with household tools disabled. Search uses Brave strict SafeSearch and only the domains below; questions, including health questions, go to Brave and your local model. Avoid sharing personal or identifying details. Source excerpts are stored locally and may reveal the topic. They are reused for up to six hours; expired cache records are removed on the next search. No new subscription is created. Search excerpts and AI answers can be incomplete or wrong, and content screening is not perfect. Non-graphic health, body and puberty education remains available. A parent can edit the style prompt; fixed safety and tool restrictions still apply. Reset restores the default prompt. Blank credentials reuse one unambiguous existing Brave configuration; saved keys are never shown. Save through Review and save; this form does not play audio or query providers.

data.knowledge_domains: Allowed source domains, one per line (includes their subdomains)
data.knowledge_daily_limit: Maximum Brave requests per rolling day
data.knowledge_monthly_limit: Maximum Brave requests per rolling 31 days

native_audio_recovery.title: Recover built-in speaker
native_audio_recovery.description: Only confirm after checking that pending alarm audio has stopped. This clears the saved local hold; it does not stop playback or prove silence.

data.confirm_audio_stopped: I verified all pending alarm audio stopped

shared_assistant.title: Shared Assist tools (preview)
shared_assistant.description: Provide Household Voice capabilities to one ordinary Home Assistant conversation agent. This switch does not change voice pipelines or the agent prompt. Select either Assist or the Tools for Assist Home Control API; remove separately selected Household Voice APIs to avoid duplicate tools. Use the shared master prompt and filter competing built-in timer and media tools before migration. Keep source-bound recording profiles until the replacement capture path is verified. Review and save to apply. Existing live action switches remain in effect.
